html:
The First Battle of Panipat was fought on 21 April 1526 north of Delhi, where Babur, ruler of Kabul, beat Ibrahim Lodi, the last sultan of Delhi, and so founded the Mughal Empire.

Babur's army was much smaller. He chained carts together to make a wall, with gaps for his field guns and matchlock men, a method the Ottomans used. His horse archers swept around both flanks of the Lodi army and pressed it into the centre, where the guns did their work. The Lodi war elephants panicked under the noise. Ibrahim died on the field with thousands of his men.

It was one of the first battles in India where gunpowder weapons decided the day. Babur took Delhi and Agra, and in 1527 beat the Rajputs at Khanwa.

Panipat sits on the plain where invaders from the northwest met the rulers of Delhi. Two more great battles were fought there: in 1556, when Akbar secured the throne, and in 1761, when the Afghans beat the Marathas.
sum: The First Battle of Panipat was fought on 21 April 1526 north of Delhi, where Babur, ruler of Kabul, beat Ibrahim Lodi, the last sultan of Delhi, and so founded the Mughal Empire.
